children: Circle Internet Group has expanded its strategic partnership with crypto exchange platform Binance, backed by a $100 million equity investment in Circle.

The new five-year commercial agreement focuses on expanding access across emerging markets to Circle's USDC stablecoin, fiat-backed cryptocurrency designed to maintain a peg to the U.S. dollar, the companies said. Under the terms of the agreement, Binance will accelerate the promotion and integration of USDC on its platform, with a focus on emerging markets, while Circle, an internet financial platform, will provide the infrastructure services that support holding and using the digital currency, they said.

At the same time, Binance acquired a position in Circle through a private placement of class A shares at a 5% discount. Binance has agreed not to transfer the shares for a period of up to two years from the closing date, the companies said.
The companies originally established their strategic partnership in late 2024 to accelerate USDC adoption across Binance's ecosystem.
Circle shares rose 2% in premarket trading Tuesday to $96.40.
